# WA4 · Thông báo nổi (toast)

Group **WA · Khung & điều hướng** · state · Next.js: **restyle (U1)** (`(app shell)`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#toast`
- Old web: `prototype/shared/crm-ui.js#handle`
- Inventory note: Check-in and Vắng in the reception list act at once and show this toast; they open no dialog. After Check-in the row offers "Bắt đầu" (crm:start). The toast disappears after 2.8 s.
- Page key `today` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"today\"]"} → {"click":"[data-crm=\"arrive\"]"} → {"wait":".toast"}; it must show "Đã cập nhật hàng đợi".
